Package gui

Class MyReservationsController

java.lang.Object
gui.MyReservationsController
All Implemented Interfaces:
IReservationDeleter, IReservationViewer, Initializable
public class MyReservationsController extends Object implements Initializable, IReservationDeleter, IReservationViewer
Controller class for the "My Reservations" view. This class handles displaying a list of reservations for the current subscriber, allowing them to view history and cancel upcoming active reservations. It implements IReservationDeleter to handle deletion responses and IReservationViewer to receive the list of reservations from the server.
